svg.title: Pontik Cluster: only the node that holds the lease polls
svg.desc: Two hand-drawn diagrams of the same active-active Eclipse Open Integration Engine™ cluster: three nodes run at the same time, share one PostgreSQL engine database, read one SFTP inbox and send to an EHR. Without Pontik Cluster, every node polls the inbox, so the EHR can get 1001.hl7 three times, and nothing tells the nodes which one should poll. With Pontik Cluster, a lease in the engine's own PostgreSQL database names node-1 as the owner: only node-1 polls and keeps renewing its lease, while node-2 and node-3 wait on standby, Paused and ready to take over.
